title: Stability Probe — Launch Signal Workbook & KPI Scenario Tracker
content:
Purpose:
This workbook captures realistic launch signal scenarios, KPI thresholds, and mitigation playbooks for staged rollouts. It is intentionally pragmatic — a lightweight field guide for product ops + SRE + eng-owner run-throughs. Use this as the single source of truth for the next feature release runway.

Scope:
- Applies to hosted API feature rollouts and Dedicated capacity switches (v1 -> v1-quantized).
- Focus: first 30 days post-canary.
- Not included: pricing/legal signoffs (see linked artifacts).

Quick launch timeline (high level):
- Week -4: Canary config + smoke tests
- Week -1: Partner beta (5% of traffic)
- Day 0: 1st public wave (10%); watch first-hour signals
- Day 3: 50% ramp if signals green
- Day 7: Full traffic (100%) if sustained stability

Core KPIs (owner | target | amber | red):
- P50 latency (runtime) | eng-serving-runtime | < 120ms | 120-250ms | > 250ms
- Error rate (5xx per minute) | sre | < 0.1% | 0.1-0.5% | > 0.5%
- Token cost delta (per 1k tokens) | product-ops | < 10% uplift | 10-25% | >25%
- Throughput (requests/min) | infra | expected baseline +/- 15% | +/- 15-30% | >30% drop
- Quality regression (eval-set BLEU/ROC) | applied-ml | no regression | small drift flagged | significant regression -> rollback

Signal mapping to action (one-liner):
- Amber on latency: pause ramp, enable lower-seq variant, notify infra on-call
- Amber on error-rate: divert 10% to fallback model, start post-mortem triage
- Red on any core KPI: immediate partial rollback to previous model version, page #prod-launch

Risk scoring matrix (probability * impact -> score 1-9):
- Capacity undercommit: prob 2, impact 4 -> 8 (owner: infra)
- Model quality regression at scale: prob 3, impact 3 -> 9 (owner: applied-ml)
- Unexpected billing spike: prob 2, impact 3 -> 6 (owner: finance)

Readiness checklist (Pre-canary):
- [ ] Canary config validated in staging (PR: github.com/redwood-inference/serving/PR-701)
- [ ] Load test (synthetic) > expected spike | owner: release-engineering
- [ ] Alert thresholds created in Datadog + runbook linked
- [ ] Feature flags wired for incremental traffic gating
- [ ] Communication plan drafted (customer-success + GTM notes)

Canary-day checklist:
- Lead ops in Slack channel #prod-launch (owner: Priya Singh)
- Monitor dashboards: latency, errors, token-cost, ELB metrics
- Smoke queries from top 10 customers; confirm responses and prompt fidelity
- Validate fallback routing (simulate model unavailability)

Rollout waves and gating rules:
- Wave 1 (5-10%): require amber-free for 24h, no >2 brief red events
- Wave 2 (25%): require 48h green, token cost within 15%
- Wave 3 (50%): require synthetic 1h surge test pass
- Wave 4 (100%): final exec sign-off if all green at 50% for 72h

Playbook snippets:
- If error-rate spikes to red -> switch routing to pinned low-latency variant, run quick KV cache flush, open incident with SRE and set action items
- If token-cost > 20% -> enable batching and enforce per-customer token caps; product-ops to notify sales for impacted customers

Post-launch 30-day observability tasks:
- Daily: P95/P50 latency, 5xx counts, token-cost trend (owner: product-ops)
- Weekly: quality-snapshots on sentinel prompts, customer-reported defects triage (owner: applied-ml + cs)
- Day 30: launch retrospective and metric regression report (owner: Priya Singh)

Open questions / notes to self:
- Confirm Dedicated autoscale buffer for region eu-west-1 (action: ping infra lead Marta)
- Decide whether to include quantized-v2 as fallback or as primary for low-cost tiers
- Need a shorter signal window for rapid canary (15m) vs default 1h — pros/cons in notes below

Action items (short):
- Priya: schedule dry-run with SRE (by 2025-11-10)
- Evan: finalize Datadog dashboards and share links (by 2025-11-05)
- Marta: confirm autoscale headroom and cost estimate for 30-day launch (by 2025-11-07)

Appendix: quick reference links
- Runbook (Datadog): https://app.datadoghq.com/dash/launch-runbook
- Incident channel: #prod-launch (Slack)
- Post-launch retro template: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PROD/Post-Launch-Retros

Draft notes style: this doc will be iterated in product-ops meetings. Expect fragments and TODOs. If you add items, include your initials and date.
